# Verge Roofing

> Residential and commercial roofing contractors covering London, Kent, Surrey,
> Essex, Hertfordshire, Sussex and Berkshire. Re-roofs, repairs, flat roofing,
> leadwork and chimneys, guttering, storm damage, planned maintenance and
> commercial roofing.

## How we work

Every job is priced after someone has been out and looked at it. There is no
price list and no published tariff, because a figure that does not survive
contact with the roof is worth less than no figure at all.

After an enquiry: we reply the same day, sooner if water is coming in. We come
out and look, at no charge. Within 48 hours of that visit you
get photographs of what we found and one fixed written price, with scaffolding,
waste, making good and VAT included. Variations only for something neither
party could see until the roof was open, agreed in advance.

Thirty years in the trade. Fully insured. A written workmanship guarantee is
handed over with the completion photographs.

Contact: team@vergeroofing.com

## Services

- [Commercial roofing](https://vergeroofing.com/services/commercial-roofing): Industrial units, warehouses, retail parades, schools and managed blocks: single ply, built-up felt, liquid coatings and sheet repairs, programmed around occupancy.
- [Flat roofing](https://vergeroofing.com/services/flat-roofing): GRP, EPDM and torch-on felt compared honestly, why most failed flat roofs fail for the same two reasons, and what a proper job corrects.
- [Guttering, fascias and soffits](https://vergeroofing.com/services/guttering-fascias-and-soffits): Rainwater goods are unglamorous and cause an enormous amount of damage when they fail. Clearing, realigning, repair and full renewal.
- [Leadwork and chimneys](https://vergeroofing.com/services/leadwork-and-chimneys): Chimney stacks, parapets, valleys and abutments: where most roofs leak, and why a mortar fillet is doing a job only lead can do.
- [Full re-roofs](https://vergeroofing.com/services/re-roofs): When a roof is worth replacing rather than patching, what a full strip and re-cover involves, and what moves the price up or down.
- [Maintenance plans](https://vergeroofing.com/services/roof-maintenance): Annual and six-monthly roof checks with a photo report each time, so the history of the roof exists somewhere other than memory.
- [Roof repairs](https://vergeroofing.com/services/roof-repairs): Slipped tiles, failed flashings, leaks nobody has traced. What a proportionate repair involves, and how the cause is found rather than the wet patch.
- [Storm damage and insurance work](https://vergeroofing.com/services/storm-damage): Make-safe first, then a dated photographic report and a scoped quotation in the format loss adjusters accept.

## Guides

- [GRP, EPDM or felt: which flat roof and why](https://vergeroofing.com/guides/flat-roof-options-compared): The three common flat roof systems compared on what actually matters: movement, detailing, weather at install, and repairability.
- [How to read a roofing quote](https://vergeroofing.com/guides/how-to-read-a-roofing-quote): What a fair quote states, what a vague one leaves out, and the questions that separate two numbers that look the same.
- [Repair or replace: how to decide](https://vergeroofing.com/guides/repair-or-replace-a-roof): How to tell a roof with years left from one at the end of its life, and how to stop paying for the same repair twice.
- [Scaffolding and access: why it is in the price](https://vergeroofing.com/guides/scaffolding-and-access): When a roof job genuinely needs a scaffold, what a tower or a ladder can safely do, and why access is the line most often left off a quote.
- [Signs your roof needs work, and signs it does not](https://vergeroofing.com/guides/signs-your-roof-needs-work): What to look for from the ground and from the loft, what is harmless, and what genuinely warrants a call.
- [What drives the cost of a new roof](https://vergeroofing.com/guides/what-drives-the-cost-of-a-new-roof): Why roofing quotes vary so much between houses that look alike, what actually moves the number, and what should always be included.

## Areas

- [Roofing in Essex and east London](https://vergeroofing.com/roofing-in/essex-and-east): Postwar estates, interlocking concrete tile, large rear extensions and flat roofs, and open exposed positions out towards the coast.
- [Roofing in Hertfordshire and the north west suburbs](https://vergeroofing.com/roofing-in/hertfordshire-and-north-west): Nineteen-thirties semis, clay tile and slate mixes, dormers and loft conversions, and the roofs that come with mature trees.
- [Roofing in Kent and south east London](https://vergeroofing.com/roofing-in/kent-and-south-east-london): Interwar tiled semis, Kent peg tile, exposed Medway and estuary positions, and what each does to a roof.
- [Roofing in north and east London](https://vergeroofing.com/roofing-in/north-and-east-london): Victorian and Edwardian terraces, London stock slate, butterfly roofs and parapet gutters: what these roofs do, and what they need.
